productionQA.imageStyle: Final exported 1024-square WebPs viewed together against the L058 style sheet and refined/family/cast anchors: style-lock PASS, cast PASS, scene semantics PASS, no readable text.
productionQA.audioPipeline: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts coral, then repository assets:audio mono AAC 44.1kHz. G02 fragments generated independently and G05 distractors generated as complete sentences. No syllable splicing. Final M4A files were aligned with whisper-1.
productionQA.timingReview: Every sentence, G02 fragment and G05 wrong-choice audio has ordered per-Han timing metadata within final duration. Exact final transcript comparison PASS. This is technical timing evidence, not human audiovisual synchronization QA.
productionQA.pronunciation: All nine unique final clips transcript-match exact approved Han. AI gpt-audio checks PASS for all nine clips, including 樂 ㄩㄝˋ in 樂器/音樂, 教 ㄐㄧㄠ, 拍 ㄆㄞ and 意 ㄧˋ. This is not human acceptance.
productionQA.browserQA: Browser QA fallback: current remote control has no reliable computer-audio return or physical-phone microphone channel. Human continuous listening, syllable-by-syllable highlight synchronization and G02 phone recording/replay were not certified. All required non-browser media, transcript, timing, format and package gates are run; teacher subjective review remains post-merge by default.
productionQA.manualPlayback: Not claimed. Teacher manual playback is post-merge by default.
